products.name: Speechmatics
products.note: Speech-to-text; real-time translation; accent-agnostic; UK-hosted; GDPR

profile_text.body:
Speechmatics is a speech technology company founded in 2006 and headquartered in Cambridge, United Kingdom. The company describes itself as building speech-to-text APIs designed for real conversations rather than controlled demos, with its technology handling accents, multiple speakers, and multilingual speech. Its platform supports batch transcription of recorded files and live audio processing, returning transcripts for use cases such as captions, search, analytics, records, and voice AI applications.

The company's core product is a speech-to-text API that covers 55 or more languages within a single model, including support for code-switching when speakers move between languages mid-conversation. It also offers text-to-speech capability, and its site notes that a model called Linden, built specifically for voice agents, is available through LiveKit Inference. Speechmatics describes target applications including contact center productivity, live captioning, meeting transcription, and voice agents, with UK hosting and GDPR compliance noted as part of its offering.

The held facts confirm Speechmatics has an active profile on theworldofai.org, with its product catalogued under the Voice and Audio category and described as accent-agnostic. No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
